title: Core DSPy Types and LM Interactions
summary: This module defines the fundamental data structures for interacting with Language Models in DSPy, including request/response formats, message types, streaming events, and configuration options. It standardizes how DSPy components communicate with LMs.

nodes.label: LM Request Object
nodes.title: LM Request Object
nodes.description: Represents a standardized request to a Language Model, encapsulating model, messages, tools, and configuration for a call.

nodes.label: Create System Message
nodes.title: System Message Creator
nodes.description: Function to construct an LM message with the 'system' role, providing model-level instructions like tone or formatting rules.

nodes.label: Create Developer Message
nodes.title: Developer Message Creator
nodes.description: Function to construct an LM message with the 'developer' role, for implementation guidance separate from user requests.

nodes.label: Create User Message
nodes.title: User Message Creator
nodes.description: Function to construct an LM message with the 'user' role, containing the primary request or data for the model.

nodes.label: Create Assistant Message
nodes.title: Assistant Message Creator
nodes.description: Function to construct an LM message with the 'assistant' role, representing a previous model response in a multi-turn conversation.

nodes.label: Create Tool Result Message
nodes.title: Tool Result Message Creator
nodes.description: Function to construct an LM message with the 'tool' role, sending the output of a tool execution back to the model.

nodes.label: Synchronous LM Stream
nodes.title: Synchronous LM Stream Handler
nodes.description: Manages synchronous streaming of Language Model responses, processing events and building the final LMResponse.

nodes.label: Asynchronous LM Stream
nodes.title: Asynchronous LM Stream Handler
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous streaming of Language Model responses, processing events and building the final LMResponse.

nodes.label: LM Call History Record
nodes.title: LM History Entry
nodes.description: A typed record of an LM call, storing the request, response, and derived convenience fields for historical analysis.

nodes.label: Tool Choice Configuration
nodes.title: LM Tool Choice Config
nodes.description: Defines controls for how Language Models should use tools, including mode and allowed tool names.

nodes.label: Reasoning Configuration
nodes.title: LM Reasoning Config
nodes.description: Specifies configuration for Language Models with native reasoning capabilities, such as effort level or summary.

nodes.label: DSPy Cache Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Cache Config
nodes.description: Controls DSPy's internal memoization cache, enabling or disabling caching for exact request matches.

nodes.label: Provider Prompt Cache Config
nodes.title: LM Prompt Cache Config
nodes.description: Configures provider-side prompt or token caching, potentially reducing latency and cost for repeated prompts.

nodes.label: JSON Serialization Helper
nodes.title: JSON Default Serializer
nodes.description: A utility function to handle serialization of Pydantic models and other objects into JSON format.

nodes.label: Text Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Text Delta
nodes.description: Represents a partial text update received during an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: Thinking Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Thinking Delta
nodes.description: Represents a partial update indicating the LM's internal thinking process during a streaming response.

nodes.label: Tool Call Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Tool Call Delta
nodes.description: Represents a partial update for a tool call, including ID, name, and arguments, during an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: Citation Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Citation Delta
nodes.description: Represents a partial update containing citation information during an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: Image Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Image Delta
nodes.description: Represents a partial update containing image data during an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: Audio Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Audio Delta
nodes.description: Represents a partial update containing audio data during an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: Stream Start Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Start Event
nodes.description: An event signaling the beginning of an LM streaming response, often including the model used.

nodes.label: Stream Delta Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Delta Event
nodes.description: An event containing a partial update (delta) to the LM's output during a streaming response.

nodes.label: Stream Output End Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Output End Event
nodes.description: An event signaling the completion of a specific output segment within an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: Stream End Event
nodes.title: LM Stream End Event
nodes.description: An event signaling the complete end of an LM streaming response, often including usage and cost information.

nodes.label: LM Message
nodes.title: Language Model Message
nodes.description: A fundamental data structure representing a single message in an LM conversation, with a role and content parts.

nodes.label: LM Tool Specification
nodes.title: LM Tool Spec
nodes.description: Defines the specification for a tool that a Language Model can use or call.

nodes.label: LM Configuration
nodes.title: LM Config
nodes.description: Aggregates various configuration settings for a Language Model request, including caching, reasoning, and tool choices.

nodes.label: LM Response Object
nodes.title: Language Model Response
nodes.description: Represents the complete response from a Language Model, including generated outputs, usage, and metadata.

nodes.label: LM Stream Event
nodes.title: LM Stream Event Base
nodes.description: Base type for all events emitted during a Language Model streaming response.

nodes.label: Any Stream Delta
nodes.title: LM Any Delta
nodes.description: A union type representing any possible partial update (delta) that can occur during an LM streaming response.

nodes.label: LM Usage Statistics
nodes.title: LM Usage
nodes.description: Statistics related to the usage of a Language Model call, such as token counts.

nodes.label: LM Tool Result Part
nodes.title: LM Tool Result Part
nodes.description: A specific part within an LM message representing the result of a tool execution.

nodes.label: LM Citation Part
nodes.title: LM Citation Part
nodes.description: A specific part within an LM message representing a citation.

nodes.label: LM Image Part
nodes.title: LM Image Part
nodes.description: A specific part within an LM message representing an image.

nodes.label: LM Audio Part
nodes.title: LM Audio Part
nodes.description: A specific part within an LM message representing audio.

groups.label: LM Request/Response Core
groups.title: LM Request/Response Core
groups.description: Central components for defining and tracking Language Model requests and their historical records.

groups.label: Message Constructors
groups.title: Message Constructors
groups.description: Functions for creating various types of messages (system, user, assistant, tool results) for LM interactions.

groups.label: LM Call Configuration
groups.title: LM Call Configuration
groups.description: Data structures for configuring specific aspects of Language Model calls, such as tool usage, reasoning, and caching.

groups.label: Streaming Interfaces
groups.title: Streaming Interfaces
groups.description: Classes that manage the synchronous and asynchronous streaming of Language Model responses.

groups.label: Streaming Events
groups.title: Streaming Events
groups.description: Types representing different events that occur during an LM streaming response, from start to end.

groups.label: Streaming Deltas
groups.title: Streaming Deltas
groups.description: Specific types of partial updates (deltas) that can be received during an LM streaming response, such as text, thinking, or tool calls.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions for common tasks like JSON serialization.
